create_standard_garbage_collector: create a StandardGarbageCollector that runs gc.collect every N steps during training
use_garbage_collector_context_manager: use a GarbageCollector as a context manager to temporarily disable Python gc
enable_standard_garbage_collector: enable a StandardGarbageCollector to disable Python gc and perform an initial collection
step_garbage_collector: call step on a StandardGarbageCollector to trigger periodic generation 1 garbage collection
use_noop_garbage_collector: use the NOOP_GARBAGE_COLLECTOR singleton as a no-op placeholder for garbage collection
